snippet.title: Athar: Echoes of Time | Alpha Reveal Trailer #gaming #islam #strategy
snippet.description:
Athar: Echoes of Time is a fast-paced, intense strategy card game inspired by the legends, scholars, and warriors of Islamic History. Command powerful Units, unlock hidden synergies, and reshape the battlefield with every move.

• Build your deck
• Conquer the board
• Rewrite history

Discover more at: www.playathar.com
